transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for being here. We've got 30 kilograms of apples to sort this weekend into family use, community pantry donation, and freezer storage. I'll be making the final call on the split, but I want to go around the table first so each of you can share any practical details that should shape the plan. We've got clean one-kilogram boxes, freezer containers, labels, and a kitchen scale ready to go. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I spoke with Grandma yesterday, and she specifically asked for exactly 6 kilograms of the apples to be peeled and cooked into unsweetened applesauce because chewing whole apples is difficult for her. I wanted to make sure the group knows this before we decide on the split.

transcript.text: I can share some good news on the pantry side. I confirmed with the community pantry coordinator that they can accept exactly 12 kilograms of whole apples, packed as twelve labeled one-kilogram boxes, with delivery on Sunday at 10:00. So that option is locked in and ready for us if we go that route.
